_comment: Whitelist of channels uploading full features under licence or public domain. 'ref' is an @handle or a UC... id. 'eu' flags general playability outside the US. Hindi/Bollywood channels were removed deliberately: they were 28% of indexed uploads for 6% of published films, because the titles are Devanagari with heavy marketing and the dubbed releases are frequently absent from IMDb under the dubbed name.
_currentReleases: currentReleases marks a channel that is the rights holder for current releases, so §5's recent-year hard flag does not fire on it -- the spec's premise for that flag is 'a recent theatrical title on a FREE channel', which is not what these are. Set it only with evidence: the four here have a median resolved year of 1995-2017 and, across the 333 recent-year uploads that also clear the score floor, a median runtime delta against IMDb of 0.00%. It stays off for the archive channels (PizzaFlix median 1943, Public Domain Movies 1954, Grjngo 1968), where a modern match is anomalous and is in fact where every wrong match in that bucket was found.
